I've planned round 288: a small fix-up for FIX-PD-1a2, the stage where products with no price show "Price unavailable" instead of `$0`. The decision is **CONTINUE**. The advisor was available and I consulted it twice. I changed no app source; the store tree still holds only A's 7 round-287 paths.

**What happened in round 287:** C failed it on one Low finding, C-R287-01. C's browser checks really ran (`browserVerified: true`) and 12 rows passed at both viewports. All three cards (version card, `/store` card and home card) now say "Price unavailable" where HEAD showed `$0` or "Complimentary". The one failure is that the smaller label makes the card shorter: 12 px on `/store`, 8 px on home. In the SFX filter, that card's bottom edge no longer lines up with the card next to it. The cause was my own spec: it required the small text and an unchanged card size, without saying which rule wins. Gate 287 was skipped, so the baseline is still `096fa4b` and A's work stays uncommitted. C-R286-01 and C-R286-02 are fixed in the tree but not marked done (მზადაა) yet; they close when round 288 passes and is published.

**My ruling:** the card keeps its height. The "Price unavailable" text gets the same line height as a normal price (`leading-8` on `/store`, `leading-7` on home). I tested this first in the browser on A's tree with C's priceless test data. The cards came out at exactly HEAD's heights (589.6 px and 417.6 px) at both viewports. The version card is frozen; C measured it unchanged at 124 px.

**What round 288 does:**
- **Code:** one class string in `store.tsx`, one in `ProductCard.tsx`, and one fix in `product-utils.ts`. That fix covers a bug A's code reviewer found: a broken Premium price (e.g. −5) showed `$-5` on the card while the purchase panel said "Price unavailable". I ruled it Low and included it here because the file is already owned and it is the same "card must match page" problem.
- **Tests:** three listed test assertions are replaced, not removed. Two new test rows (PR10, VC5) and four new mutants (N7–N10) are added.
- **C's checks:** measured line height and card heights against HEAD, the bad-Premium product page using a new `bad-premium-track` test product, the earlier round-287 rows, the store-card-to-page journey across 10 products, and the auth guard.
- **Baseline copy:** A's 7 round-287 files are copied to `b-round-287/k2-snapshot/`, so C can compare against them on a fresh machine.

**Backlog:** decisions D-29z704 to D-29z706 are recorded. The reviewer's note about a `?? 0` in `productAdapter.ts` is kept as a signal only, since no page uses that code. Two other reviewer Lows went to `deferred_low_polish`. `lessons.md` is unchanged: the existing lessons L3 and L4 already cover my mistake. No frontend-architect checkpoint is needed for a fix-up this small.

**What comes next:** the regression round is due if round 289 is planned on or after 2026-11-02, and the retrospective is at round 290. After that the queue continues with FIX-PD-1b, FIX-PD-1c, STUDIO-LINK, NAME-AND-HINT and PERF-3c. Nothing is ready to commit until C passes round 288.
